title: SB51 (2020 Regular): authorize the possession of a concealed pistol by employees in county courthouses.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2020-01-16; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/62495.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 62495, BillId 11505))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2020-01-16 (as filed). New subdivision (6) added to SDCL 22-14-24 (old (6) renumbered (7)); the word 'and' after (d) struck. No vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (SDCL 22-14-24): The possession of a firearm or other dangerous weapon in a county courthouse by any person who is employed by the county and assigned to work in the county courthouse; and (7) The lawful carrying of a firearm or other dangerous weapon in a county courthouse incident to a hunter safety or a gun safety course or for any other lawful purposes.
Section 2 (SDCL 22-14-28): A waiver by the county commission in accordance with this section supersedes subdivision 6 of § 22-14-24 governing county employees.
